title: vote/v1
description: targets/<id>/votes/<n>.yaml (F24-R3; D-32 v3.34): one panel member's vote on one motion, cast inside its window. A member may vote again inside the window; their latest vote counts. A steward who holds proof credit on the target votes, but the vote is not counted on verify-writeup or authorship-threshold. Append-only; versioned, never edited (D-34).

motion.description: The motion's number n in targets/<id>/motions/<n>.yaml.

date.description: The day the record was made (UTC). The gate refuses a record dated more than one day from its own clock, so a date cannot be written into an old window.

via.description: How the signature was made (D-3, D-32 v3.33): `ssh`, by the signer's own SSH key; `approval-key`, by the network's approval key through the service, for a login signed in with GitHub on the site, in which case `key` must equal the graph's keys/approval.pub in the merge's parent tree.

key.description: The SSH public key the signature verifies under: the steward's own (`via: ssh`) or the network's approval key (`via: approval-key`).

signature.description: An OpenSSH SSHSIG armored signature over the record's canonical body, made with the private half of `key`.
